programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of My Feet Are Killing Me: First Steps. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: In the age of social media, the demand for illegal steroids is booming. Mariana searches out producers and users in an attempt to understand the vanity, insecurity and greed that's driving this dangerously unregulated, billion-dollar black market in body-enhancing drugs.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Fentanyl has turbocharged the deadliest drug crisis in American history. But less understood is how the drug has utterly transformed the black market. Mariana goes in search of the new bosses, new routes, new risks and the American communities paying the price for fentanyl's next wave.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana heads to the Congo to investigate the illegal trade in wild apes that have them on the brink of extinction. She'll follow the supply chain from the poachers to the middlemen and ultimately to the buyers, many in the Middle East, who use these apes as pets and in sideshow attractions. She'll also spend time with Congolese activists who are fighting to protect apes from extinction.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: What do you see when you look at the world? Does reality really exist the way you experience it? Your brain is constantly taking in different bits of information all at once to make meaningful patterns that eventually form a complete picture of the world around you. Whether it's light, shadow, distance, or sound, the way your brain perceives this information creates your unique perspective. But have you ever stopped to wonder if your brain is actually being fooled-or if your brain is fooling you? In this episode of Brain Games, you'll see how your brain gets tripped up by odd angles, how light and shadows play a crucial role in your perception of the world, how you can radically shift the way you see reality, and how your brain isn't always as honest with you as you think. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover why you shouldn't always believe what you see.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Like all living beings, humans are survivors. The immutable evolutionary laws of Nature have winnowed out the weak over millions of years. In this episode we deconstruct the neuroscience behind human survival how we evolved to survive, and what role our ancient instincts still play today in keeping us alive. Get ready for some mind-boggling adventures of the human mind on this episode of Brain Games V.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The community of Port Protection is strengthened by the individual in a constant quest to persevere against nature's changing obstacles. Surrounded by helpful neighbors, Gary builds a new - and safer - section of boardwalk leading to his house. Meanwhile, Mary tests the skills Curly taught her in her first solo wood harvest and learns the hard way that she's not quite ready for the challenge of big cedars. Sam, Stuart, and Squib enact a search and rescue drill with the help of Matt and a homemade dummy in the dense and treacherous forest. And Curly takes his annual trip to the dump in Craig to unload a year's worth of garbage on a temporary truck repair that could derail the entire mission. These seemingly simple tasks are made more difficult by weather and limited resources as the battle to find balance between man and nature continues in Port Protection.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: As a strange winter comes to a close, the citizens of Port Protection continue to combat an ever-unpredictable nature. Our characters confront the tenuousness of this Alaskan lifestyle-and they must reconcile with the mental and physical limits they're capable of reaching before they must move back to the comforts of civilization. Curly Leach brings his chainsaw to Jiggy Nichols' home, where a collapsed tree threatens to push Jiggy's livelihood off a cliff. Meanwhile, Sam Carlson and his son Matt take a winter camping trip to a remote clam bed, chasing after a source of protein that the ecosystem has suddenly made scarce. The Porters rush to prepare their farm for baby goats, but in his haste Hans has a shocking accident with his chainsaw. Finally, Amanda Makar puts her livelihood and her friends in harm's way as she attempts to extract the decrepit engines from her houseboat.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: TACA Airlines Flight #110 Boeing 737-300 series May 24th, 1988 Flying through a violent thunderstorm, TACA Flight #110 begins its final descent towards New Orleans when both engines quit and the plane begins dropping from the sky. The pilots restart both engines but almost immediately they overheat forcing the pilots to shut them down. Without power for the second time and falling fast, they consider ditching the plane in a canal but aim instead for a narrow grass levee. With 38 passengers bracing for a crash, the pilots manage one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation. Then it's up to investigators to determine why the engines of a brand new Boeing 737 failed in mid-flight.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: SAS Flight #686 Boeing MD-87 October 8th, 2001 A heavy fog blankets Milan's Linate Airport as SAS Flight #686 prepares for a routine flight to Copenhagen. Facing almost zero-visibility, the pilots rely entirely on ground controllers as they navigate into position for takeoff. The plane accelerates down the runway, but as it lifts off it collides with a Cessna in its path. The Cessna erupts in flames. The MD-87 slams to the ground and slides into an baggage hangar. The plane explodes on impact. It is the worst accident in Italian aviation history and the investigation uncovers a shocking series of errors. In the aftermath, an airport is transformed and those deemed responsible are sentenced in court.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: The summer season is frantic for maritime authorities. As drug boats and small dinghies sail towards Spanish territory, small vessels wait offshore to refuel them. Additionally, with the surge in tourism, the number of boats and jet skis multiplies. The Spanish Coastguards will have to confront situations that could end in tragedy.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: In Almería, a patrol boat tries to seize two empty dinghies on the coast after unloading occupants from an illegal journey. But that's not the only alert. Colleagues chase drug trafficking rafts in Cádiz and the Balearic Islands, while investigating the black market for engines at the Huelva dock. These adventures will reveal the untold stories of those who stand against crime on the sea.

programme.title: The Mob's Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: The St. Valentine's Day massacre is the stuff of American legend, and the tale is familiar to nearly everyone. But the story of that bloody day in Chicago has never been told, or seen, like this before. Cutting-edge graphics and frenetic recreations accompany Johnny Fratto, son of onetime Al Capone-associate Louis "Lew" Fratto, back to Chicago, where he uncovers massacre myths and learns more about the life his father and uncles led when they roamed those lawless streets in the 1920s. Johnny gets guidance and opinions from a team of renowned Chicago gangster experts, and bridges the gap between the stories he heard as a little boy and the reality he lived growing up in a mob family. Johnny's take about what happened on Feb. 14, 1929 will surprise you.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Marine agents in Miami intercept a boat suspected of smuggling narcotics. After a destructive search, they find over 500 kilos of cocaine concealed in the cabin. Meanwhile, in Mississippi, U.S. Border Patrol agents launch an operation on a major highway they suspect is being used by cartels to smuggle drugs, money and people. Off the coast of Florida, agents patrol a route popular with smugglers bringing in contraband from the Bahamas.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: Marine agents in Fort Lauderdale are on the hunt for a large shipment of drugs leaving the U.S. With the help of the U.S Coast Guard, they successfully intercept a boat found to be carrying 10 pounds of marijuana. In Gulfport, Mississippi, U.S. Border Patrol agents police the I-10, a notorious smuggling route. Meanwhile, agents patrol the waters for smugglers bringing in illicit goods under the cover of darkness.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: TAM Airlines Flight #3054 Airbus A320 July 17th, 2007 - TAM Airlines Flight #3054 is on its final approach to Sao Paulo's notorious Congonhas Airport. Runway 35-L at Congonhas is one of the most treacherous in the world. It's built on a hilltop, surrounded by tall buildings. The crew of Flight #3054 gets a report that the runway is wet and slippery. Captain Henrique Stephanini brings his Airbus A-320 down at the foot of the 1,945 meter long runway, activates the one working thrust reverser and applies the brakes, but his plane doesn't slow down. It hurtles down the runway at top speed, crosses a highway and slams into a building and adjacent gas station. No one on the plane survives. 12 people on the ground are also killed. This is the worst aviation disaster in South American history. Investigators are under enormous pressure to figure out what went wrong on one of Brazil's busiest runways, before it claims any more lives.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 McDonnell Douglas DC-9-82 (MD-82) August 16th, 2005 - Hours behind schedule, West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 finally takes off from Panama City en route to Martinique. The aircraft flies toward weather so severe that the pilots must divert to avoid it. In addition to the turbulence, the pilots have another problem; their engines are not providing enough thrust. To solve this issue the pilots drop down to a lower altitude, but before they can reach it a Stall Warning fills the cockpit. The plane is flying too slowly to remain airborne. Before the pilots can figure out what has caused the problem, the aircraft drops from the sky and crashes on a remote Venezuelan farm. By far the worst aviation disaster in the country's history, a small team of Venezuelan investigators must now determine what brought down one of the safest airplanes in the world.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: It's a foggy day at Ireland's Cork Airport and the pilots of Manx2 Flight 7100 are circling the airport waiting for the weather to clear. After controllers clear the turboprop commuter plane for landing, the pilots reduce their speed and descend, but the aircraft suddenly goes into a severe roll and crashes into the runway. It's the deadliest crash in Ireland in decades, and it's up to the Irish Air Accident Investigation Unit to figure out what went wrong. They soon discover the fog is only part of the story, and the investigation reveals a startling gap in aviation safety that has put passengers' lives at risk.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: CBP officers in the Port of Savannah intercept a suspiciously heavy shipping container bound for Ghana — and it's full of stolen cars. Officers at New Orleans International Airport question a man arriving from Honduras, after the K-9 enforcement team flags his suitcase as potentially containing narcotics. In Florida, Air and Marine Operations agents patrol a smuggling hotspot, as they search for jettisoned contraband.

programme.title: Facing...
programme.desc: Facing is a documentary series that tells the stories of a broad range of global iconic, and often notorious, individuals through the eyes and unique experiences of those who 'faced' them - the brave few who dared to oppose the most accomplished and often feared people who have ever lived. And who better to dive into their psyches and peel back the layers of their successes and struggles than the people who helped shaped them through conflict, confrontation, and camaraderie.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat, cocaine smuggling. A woman is caught trafficking cocaine inside packets of hair bleach. When she's hit with a dramatic fainting spell, officers fear the worst. Agents uncover nearly three kilos of cocaine inside photos of the Pope. And a man who attempted to run from police is arrested, his luggage lined with cocaine.

It hurtles down the runway at top speed, crosses a highway and slams into a building and adjacent gas station. No one on the plane survives. 12 people on the ground are also killed. This is the worst aviation disaster in South American history. Investigators are under enormous pressure to figure out what went wrong on one of Brazil's busiest runways, before it claims any more lives.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 McDonnell Douglas DC-9-82 (MD-82) August 16th, 2005 - Hours behind schedule, West Caribbean Airways Flight #708 finally takes off from Panama City en route to Martinique. The aircraft flies toward weather so severe that the pilots must divert to avoid it. In addition to the turbulence, the pilots have another problem; their engines are not providing enough thrust. To solve this issue the pilots drop down to a lower altitude, but before they can reach it a Stall Warning fills the cockpit. The plane is flying too slowly to remain airborne. Before the pilots can figure out what has caused the problem, the aircraft drops from the sky and crashes on a remote Venezuelan farm. By far the worst aviation disaster in the country's history, a small team of Venezuelan investigators must now determine what brought down one of the safest airplanes in the world.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Repatriating Indian nationals from Dubai in the midst of the COVID-19 epidemic, Air India Express Flight 1344 is on final approach to Calicut airport amid heavy showers, reduced visibility, and strong winds. The treacherous tabletop runway leaves no margin for error. And after a first missed attempt, the Boeing 737-800 touches down—yet fails to stop—and plunges into a gorge. The aircraft breaks apart on impact, killing 21 people, including the two pilots. At first, investigators suspect a problem with the braking system. But they soon discover a shocking malfunction of an entirely different nature. For some reason, the aircraft came in above the glide slope, flew well past the touchdown zone, and ran out of runway. And the fatal cause is logged on the cockpit voice recorder.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: TAM Airlines Flight #3054 Airbus A320 July 17th, 2007 - TAM Airlines Flight #3054 is on its final approach to Sao Paulo's notorious Congonhas Airport. programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: In an eye-opening journey through her home state of California, Mariana embeds with pimps, victims, undercover cops and private investigators to understand the ugly business of illicit sex in America. How do pimps recruit? How do they think? Where do they get their power? And just how far will they go to grab their share of this billion-dollar black market?

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana uncovers a lethal supply chain of American firearms being smuggled into the hands of drug cartels and fueling record levels of gun violence throughout Mexico. The story takes an even more terrifying turn when the son of the world's most notorious drug lord, El Chapo Guzman, is arrested and the cartel Mariana has infiltrated violently revolts.

In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Like all living beings, humans are survivors. The immutable evolutionary laws of Nature have winnowed out the weak over millions of years. In this episode we deconstruct the neuroscience behind human survival how we evolved to survive, and what role our ancient instincts still play today in keeping us alive. Get ready for some mind-boggling adventures of the human mind on this episode of Brain Games V.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Its a fact of life. From the minute were born, were all getting older. And while its long been believed that both your body and your brain deteriorate over time, recent studies show that may not always be the case. Some brain functions improve as we get older, while other dont fully develop until later in life! In this episode we explore your brain and how it doesnt always act its age. Through a series of games and experiments, you'll discover how your daily routines might be aging your brain . . . and how you can actually slow down the clock. And if you pay attention, youll discover the surprising answer about whether older brains or younger brains come out on top in this Brain Games "Battle of the Ages".

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Think your field of vision is really in focus, or that your brain is focusing on everything happening in front of you? Think you know exactly what is most important at any given moment? Think again. This episode of Brain Games puts your focus and attention to the ultimate test with a series of interactive games and fascinating experiments that reveal how your neural hard-wiring can affect what your brain chooses to focus on right now!

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The community takes advantage of unseasonably warm winter weather to complete necessary builds and essential chores. By building a greenhouse, Hans and Timbi take another giant step toward realizing their dream of owning and operating a fully functioning subsistence farm. After overcoming a multitude of obstacles, and almost losing their valuable smoker, the team harnesses their strength to finish the build and is one-step closer to bringing fresh produce to the village. Meanwhile, Sam challenges himself by building experimental octopus pots, a first for him. He sets out to sea to catch octopus, but the treacherous waters surrounding Port Protection may prove too much for even a seasoned mariner like Sam. Across the island, Gary Muehlberger reaches the inland waterways of Prince of Wales to catch river trout, but mistiming the tides has put his trip in doubt. Finally, a pesky vermin has bee been tunneling holes under Mary's home and eating her salmon, venison, and cat food. Curly, drawing on years of trapping experience, builds a live-trap to help rid her property of mink.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Hans and Timbi Porter collect the necessary ingredients for their greenhouse compost while their friends and volunteers build the interior grow beds. After a violent storm, Sam and his son Matt help their neighbor Stuart Andrews retrieve his sunken skiff. The three men work together to rebuild the community work float, so Stuart has a safe place to make repairs. Timothy "Curly" Leach sets out on his first king salmon fishing trip, hoping to get a head start on the summer season. And Mary Miller grapples with her poor health, making the hundred-mile trip to Craig, Alaska to see her doctor.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: United Airlines Flight #232 DC-10 July 19th, 1989 United Airlines Flight #232 is 37,000 feet over Iowa when one of its three engines explodes. The pilots shut it down but soon discover they have a much more serious problem on their hands. The plane is in a steep right bank, and the pilots are unable to restore its flight path. The DC-10 has suffered a complete failure of all hydraulic systems, and the pilots have no way to maneuver the plane other than by alternating the power to the two remaining engines. The pilots manage to fly the crippled plane to the nearest airport but, unable to configure the wings for a normal landing, they have no choice but to keep the engines at nearly full power. After a crash that claims 111 of the 296 people on board, it's up to investigators to figure out how a foolproof system failed.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The Lockheed Electra was the workhorse of Reeve Aleutian Airways, one of the few links from Cold Bay, Alaska, to the outside world. But on June 8, 1983, the plane nearly plunged 19,000 feet into the Pacific Ocean after one of its propellers tore from the aircraft and cut a hole through the cabin. Join us as we document this incredible story of survival, from the cockpit to the cabin, with witness accounts, official records, and dramatic recreations.

programme.title: Colossal Machines
programme.desc: Catastrophic events often require life-saving machines, and to function reliably, they have a certain technological mystery. Emergency teams risk their lives when fighting earthquakes, forest fires and extreme nature events. With climate change affecting the globe and extreme situations occurring more often, advanced technology is a priority when designing machines that need to save lives.

programme.title: Colossal Machines
programme.desc: A huge part of our economy is reliant upon freight transport. Industries from all over the world depend on freight aircraft, offshore vessels and electric trains to increase overall productivity. Experts investigate how these colossal transporters are designed to carry massive amounts of goods quickly and efficiently.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: At Toronto International Airport, multiple challenges push staff to their limits. An oversold flight needs passengers to surrender their seats, but will any volunteer? Cracked windows risk grounding a Dreamliner - they're still airworthy, but would anyone feel safe sitting beside them? And a rookie firefighter faces her biggest challenge, driving a state-of-the-art fire truck on a live airfield.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: An Airside Electrical team investigates faulty airfield lights and finds that rodents, taking refuge from the brutal Canadian winter, have damaged the cabling. On the ramp, high winds make loading cargo difficult, and mean jets can't start their engines without help from one of the unsung heroes of the airport. And in security screening a scan reveals possible explosives in a passenger's baggage. Final

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: A small-time tow-trucker calls in Thord to help rescue a tractor. But as they start to pull, a tow truck slides on the ice and risks joining the tractor in a creek. In Overhalla, Raido and the Rørvik crew try to rescue a truck and trailer that crashed against a cliff face. The pressures on when one wrong move could rip the trailer apart.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: A small-time tow-trucker calls in Thord to help rescue a tractor. But as they start to pull, a tow truck slides on the ice and risks joining the tractor in a creek. High in the mountains, Bjoern joins the emergency services on a winter rescue exercise. But for Bjoern, practice turns into reality when a car driver slides into a ditch to avoid a head on collision. In Overhalla, Raido and the Rørvik crew try to rescue a truck and trailer that crashed against a cliff face. The pressures on when one wrong move could rip the trailer apart.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight #1285 DC-8 December 12th, 1985 - After a six-month peace-keeping mission in the Middle East, 248 elite American soldiers are on their way home for the holidays. Destined for Fort Campbell, Kentucky, they are travelling on Arrow Air Flight #1285, a charter air carrier contracted by the military to transport troops. En route from Cairo, the DC-8 eventually touches down for a routine refueling stop in Gander, Newfoundland. But just seconds after taking off again for the last leg of its journey, the plane loses airspeed and altitude and crashes into a heavily wooded area just south of the runway. An unprecedented disaster, it is one of the deadliest aviation accidents of all time and the resulting investigation ignites a storm of controversy that continues to this day.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Continental Express Flight #2574 Embraer 120 Brasilia On its second routine trip of the morning, Continental Express Flight #2574 is nearing the end of its one-hour flight from Laredo to Houston, Texas. A state-of-the-art Embraer 120 Brasilia, the commuter plane is scheduled to make several more short flights. But just as the pilots are preparing for descent, the plane falls out of the sky. Dropping thousands of feet in mere seconds, there is a massive explosion as the aircraft crashes into a farmer's field. All 14 people on board die in the disaster, and the impact is so violent that the wreckage is barely recognizable as an airplane. Investigators consider that there was a bomb on board, but when the theory is dismissed, they dig deeper and eventually reveal a chilling story of good intentions gone horribly wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Access 360° World Heritage
programme.desc: The palaces, cathedrals and museums of St. Petersburg represent some of the finest art and architecture on earth. This UNESCO World Heritage site was built as the shining symbol of the Russian empire's golden age. But behind the gold curtain, a dark history has left some of Russia's greatest treasures on the brink. Now a select few must safeguard these cherished relics of the past to reveal the city's splendor once again.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.desc: Lelouch learns that the Chinese Empress Tianzi is being forced into a political marriage to First Prince Odysseus u Britannia. The wedding is orchestrated by the High Eunuchs, who will become nobility in Britannia in exchange for turning over half their land to Second Prince Schneizel el Britannia. As the wedding begins, Li Xingke initiates a coup-d'état to overthrow the Eunuchs, but before he can free the Empress, Lelouch appears and takes her hostage. Elsewhere, V.V. prepares to unleash Jeremiah Gottwald against Lelouch and C.C.

In the south, a truck parked up for the night starts sliding on sheet ice. During the rescue, Thord discovers that the accident could have been much worse, because the truck was close to careering down a steep bank when the driver was asleep. Thord's young recruit Gabriel also gets a shock during his first solo mission. Called out to rescue a car that's slammed into a cliff face, he realises that the car is a write-off - but is then surprised to find the four occupants in party mood.

programme.title: Storm Squad
programme.desc: Documentary following an elite team of search and rescue workers from Texas A&M Task Force 1. When Tropical Storm Imelda brought record-breaking flash flooding to Southeast Texas in September 2019, the team battle to save lives and evacuate stranded residents from a community that had been devastated by Hurricane Harvey just two years earlier.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Korean Air Flight 6316 is en route to Seoul with a load of non-hazardous cargo. But shortly after takeoff, the pilots struggle to navigate the skies above Shanghai. The controller notices the plane isn't climbing to its assigned altitude. And within minutes, the MD-11F disappears from radar altogether and slams into a residential neighborhood. The massive impact registers the equivalent of a 1.6-magnitude earthquake, destroys the flight data recorder, and claims the lives of five civilians and the three-man crew. Investigators from China, South Korea, and the US join forces, and are soon able to rule out both mechanical issues and sabotage. It's only when they reconstruct the flight in a simulator that the mystery begins to unravel—and they come to a startling realization.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Earth protects itself from the sun. The David and Goliath story of Earths relationship with its greatest threat, our seemingly benign Sun. The Sun is the big violent boss of the Solar System throwing out devastating particles and deadly radiation. Without several shields, one generated by our unique planetary core, another by our atmosphere, and a third by our interconnected weather systems, life on Earth would never have survived.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Earth gives birth to life. The building blocks of life are common across the universe, but life is rare. What's so special about Earth that it emerged here? Only here on Earth have we found the elixir of life; water in its three forms. But for life to emerge this isn't enough… huge tides created by the proximity of our perfect Moon, plate tectonics, volcanoes and lightning mean the Earth is a dynamic planet. It's a huge planetary chemical experiment, a bubbling cauldron that transforms dead minerals into deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA); the code for all life.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: Ever since life emerged, microbes, plants and animals have all sculpted the planets surface and atmosphere in the strangest of ways; fish poop creates islands; dead animals create mountains; plants help create continents. From rocks to rivers, life has crafted everything that makes our planet so special. But this power of change brings with it profound dangers. Life doesnt just create. It can also destroy.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Think you understand the colors you see every day? Think an apple is actually red, or a leaf is really green? Think again. This episode of Brain Games puts your brain to the ultimate test with a series of interactive games and fascinating experiments that will reveal a shocking truth—color is just an illusion created by your brain. We'll show you how some colors can make you fly, reveal ghostly colors that don't actually exist, and if you play along you'll see how color helps keep you alive.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz take on a 1989 VW Golf GTi, one of the most iconic cars to have come out of the 1980s and one which just happens to be Tim Shaw's all-time favourite car. The boys challenge this time is to make this particular Golf suitable for its owner Darren, a former bus driver who was left disabled and partially sighted after a tragic road accident in which he saved the life of his young grandson.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Forfar in Scotland to rescue the rusting wreck of a rare Talbot Sunbeam Lotus. The car was the pride and joy of former firefighter, and lifelong rally enthusiast, Jim who had planned to restore it, however a back injury not only forced him to give up his job but also any plans to get his car back on the road. Once the boys get the car back in the workshop they discover they have something very special on their hands as the Talbot turns out to be an ultra-rare factory proto type.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Kent to try and salvage a 1991 VW T4 Campervan. The vehicle belongs to 42 year old carpenter Jon who bought his mobile home several year ago with the dream of taking his wife travelling around the world. Sadly before Jon's dream came true he was diagnosed with brain cancer, his whole world ground to a halt and his plans to restore and drive his beloved van had to go on hold. Will the Car SOS team be able to help resurrect Jon's dream?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Derbyshire to rescue a 48 year old Italian supercar: a 1971 Lamborghini Espada. This remarkable car belongs to lifelong petrol head Ged who bought the car in 1977 for $4000 however when it eventually broke down Ged's aim of one day restoring it to its former glory ground to a halt when serious health issues got in the way. Will the boys from Car SOS be able to make Ged's dream come true?

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam attracts 24 million tourists every year. The capital is one of Europe's leading tourist destinations. Visitors come to Amsterdam not only for the Rijksmuseum or its 165 picturesque canals, but many also for its 165 coffeeshops. Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran assist an American tourist who has fallen ill after using soft drugs. At the Ticket & Service department, Alexandra makes a game of guessing which country travelers come from. In the Lost & Found department, staff member Gusta searches for a missing backpack belonging to an American tourist. Tourists from the United Kingdom arrive at Amsterdam Central Station by high-speed train. At the dedicated UK Terminal, the team races against the clock to ensure the train to London departs on time.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Festival season has kicked off in the city, culminating in the Amsterdam Dance Event, the world's largest electronic music festival. Around 500,000 dance enthusiasts from around the world are gathering in Amsterdam to attend the festivities. This means tens of thousands of extra passengers at the station. Safety & Service staff Menno and Baran are busy dealing with visitors who are using drugs excessively. Veteran Menno tries to keep his new colleague Baran in check when he chases a troublemaker who is under the influence. Amsterdam Central is also joining in the festivities, with various stages and a special Dance Train featuring a DJ. On board, conductor Errol is transported back to his time as a party animal.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: On the west coast of Puerto Rico, Air and Marine Operations chase down and arrest smugglers caught tossing bales of cocaine overboard. At the Fort Lauderdale Airport, U.S. Customs and Border Protection seizes over a thousand hydrocodone pills from an airline pilot returning from Colombia. At Atlanta International Airport, CBP consults with archaeologists to verify the authenticity of several artifacts they suspect were looted.

programme.title: Contraband Capture
programme.desc: CBP officers in the Port of Savannah intercept a suspiciously heavy shipping container bound for Ghana — and it's full of stolen cars. Officers at New Orleans International Airport question a man arriving from Honduras, after the K-9 enforcement team flags his suitcase as potentially containing narcotics. In Florida, Air and Marine Operations agents patrol a smuggling hotspot, as they search for jettisoned contraband.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight #1285 DC-8 December 12th, 1985 - After a six-month peace-keeping mission in the Middle East, 248 elite American soldiers are on their way home for the holidays. Destined for Fort Campbell, Kentucky, they are travelling on Arrow Air Flight #1285, a charter air carrier contracted by the military to transport troops. En route from Cairo, the DC-8 eventually touches down for a routine refueling stop in Gander, Newfoundland. But just seconds after taking off again for the last leg of its journey, the plane loses airspeed and altitude and crashes into a heavily wooded area just south of the runway. An unprecedented disaster, it is one of the deadliest aviation accidents of all time and the resulting investigation ignites a storm of controversy that continues to this day.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Continental Express Flight #2574 Embraer 120 Brasilia On its second routine trip of the morning, Continental Express Flight #2574 is nearing the end of its one-hour flight from Laredo to Houston, Texas. A state-of-the-art Embraer 120 Brasilia, the commuter plane is scheduled to make several more short flights. But just as the pilots are preparing for descent, the plane falls out of the sky. Dropping thousands of feet in mere seconds, there is a massive explosion as the aircraft crashes into a farmer's field. All 14 people on board die in the disaster, and the impact is so violent that the wreckage is barely recognizable as an airplane. Investigators consider that there was a bomb on board, but when the theory is dismissed, they dig deeper and eventually reveal a chilling story of good intentions gone horribly wrong.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: On a routine flight from Surabaya, Indonesia, to Hong Kong, Cathay 780 experienced unexplained engine warnings. Over the course of its journey, both engines failed, turning the plane into a glider. Capt. Malcolm Waters uses his piloting skills to guide the plane towards Hong Kong and avoid ditching in the sea. When one engine regains partial power, hope rekindles, but now the speed is stuck. The struggling plane approaches Hong Kong for a high-speed landing. When a plane comes to a stop at the end of the runway, a brake fire triggers an emergency evacuation. The engine shutdown remained a mystery until investigators discovered an unusual source: the fuel. A storm near Surabaya's airport caused fuel contamination, leading the engines to stall. In this episode, Capt. Waters recounts his nail-biting experience in the cockpit.

programme.title: Plane Crash Recreated
programme.desc: A routine flight from London Heathrow to Belfast International Airport ended in tragedy when British Midland Flight 92 crashed onto a motorway embankment near the town of Kegworth on 8th January 1989. An engine failure meant the crew would have to make what should have been a straightforward emergency landing. Tragically, the pilots mistakenly identified and shut-off the wrong engine, leading to a catastrophic crash near the M1. In this episode, survivors give us their first-hand account of the horrific accident..

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: For ages, prophets have suggested that disastrous eventsand maybe even the end of the worldlie ahead. Experts say there is no such thing as the power of foresight and that the predictions are broadly interpreted in order to keep the myth of prophetic ability alive. Are we looking at an unquenchable human desire to make sense out of the chaos of life - or a true Paranatural power?

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most notorious unsolved skyjackings and missing person cases…and new evidence is leading the FBI to reopen their files with the belief it might finally be solved. The night before Thanksgiving, 1971, a man by the name of Dan Cooper boarded Northwest Orient Airlines flight 305 from Portland to Seattle. Several hours later, with $200,000 strapped to his body, he leapt from the plane - and into history. A reporter botched the name of the culprit, and D.B. Cooper was born. A collection of suspects and clues have emerged - a copycat crime, a bag full of Cooper's bills discovered in 1980, a deathbed confessional - but all leads have proven inconclusive. But the past year or so has seen a flurry of new clues. In 2007, new evidence emerged from a man who claims that his deceased brother - a Northwest employee and Army paratrooper - was the real D.B. Cooper. Then, in March 2008, a parachute turned up on a field where Cooper could have landed that matched the one he used. Meanwhile, new evidence released by the FBI in the past few months is generating new theories - and suspects. As the FBI reopens the case, we'll follow the same evidence trail to find out if this new information could finally bring this notorious case to a close.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Mysterious events, compelling figures and great unanswered questions from the past are explored. Most historians have reached a consensus about the way major world events played out. Yet decades after the fact, certain stories remain touched by an air of uncertainty. Investigate the truth behind some of history's greatest events and most iconic people. Discover new clues about the reclusive billionaire Howard Hughes; the CIA's top-secret experiments; the Unabomber and; little known stories from NASA's Apollo missions.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Mysterious events, compelling figures and great unanswered questions from the past are explored. Most historians have reached a consensus about the way major world events played out. programme.title: Wolves Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie is in Canada for his most remote and challenging mission yet; filming a wolf pack taking on their biggest and most dangerous prey, the moose. The only time this never-before-filmed behavior can be captured is in winter, when working conditions are at their toughest. But for Bertie, this mission is personal. He knows these wolves, and this winter is critical for the survival of the pack.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Overhalla, Jo Roger's under pressure when a crashed truck blocks the main road north-south. With no alternative routes, the crash cuts Norway in two. In the south, a truck parked up for the night starts sliding on sheet ice. During the rescue, Thord discovers that the accident could have been much worse, because the truck was close to careering down a steep bank when the driver was asleep. Thord's young recruit Gabriel also gets a shock during his first solo mission. Called out to rescue a car that's slammed into a cliff face, he realises that the car is a write-off - but is then surprised to find the four occupants in party mood.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue 10
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: Growing up, David Blaine was fascinated by images from India of extraordinary physical feats. This evolved into a life-long obsession with real performances so extreme they appear to be magical. Using secrets passed down over hundreds of years, people still perform these acts today. David unearths these modern practitioners to explore how belief and performance intersect to make magic.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In the stunning frozen landscape of the Arctic Circle, David Blaine explores humanity's curiously extreme ability to endure freezing temperatures. He meets and learns from people who reach beyond their limits to transform barriers into new frontiers and embody a sense of resilience, perseverance and grit that is unique to the region.

programme.title: David Blaine Do Not Attempt
programme.desc: In a nation once defined by apartheid, David embarks on an epic adventure in South Africa, uncovering the magic of its diverse cultures and wildlife that is reshaping perceptions and dismantling barriers in this dynamic country.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Partizan - Baskonia
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Möllukomöödia kolmas osa. Möödunud on kaks aastat. Phil, Stu ja Doug elavad kodus õnnelikku ja üksluiset elu. Ainsana pundis pole aga eluga rahul Alan. Tal pole endiselt ühtki eesmärki, ta on loobunud ravimitest ning annab igale pähekargavale mõttele kohe järele. Alani puhul tähendab see, et piire ta ei tunne, puuduvad igasugused filtrid ja kaine otsustusvõime, kuni isiklik kriis sunnib teda vajalikku abi otsima. Mõistagi aitavad just kolm sõpra tal esimest sammu astuda. Sel korral ei ole ühtegi poissmeestepidu, ei ühtegi pulma. Mis saaks küll valesti minna? Aga uskumatu, midagi siiski saab!

programme.title: Vabaduse hääl
programme.desc: Jim Caviezel ("Person of Interest") hittfilmis "Vabaduse hääl" ("Sound of Freedom"), milles endine valitsuse agent suundub eluohtlikulle missioonile, et päästa süütud lapsed lastekaubitsejate küüsist sügavas Colombia džunglis.

programme.title: A-Rühm
programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on neli meest, kes sõdisid Vietnamis ning kellele esitati valesüüdistus. Meestejõuku hüütakse A-rühmaks ning kui nende ülemus Morrison suri, otsustasid nad põgeneda. Nüüdsest pühendab rühm suurema osa oma ajast hädasolevate inimeste aitamiseks. Nad abistavad inimesi, keda koheldakse ebaõiglaselt, päästavad röövimise ohvreid, paljastavad kuritegelikke jõuke ning takistavad kurikaeltel oma plaane teostamast. Kuuldused A-rühma olemasolust jõuavad ajalehereporter Amy Allenini. Ta püüab nendega ühendust võtta ja satub seikluste keerisesse.

programme.title: Titetegu
programme.desc: USA 2010 romantiline komöödia Lavastaja:Josh Gordon, Will Speck Osades:Jennifer Aniston, Jason Bateman, Patrick Wilson, Jeff Goldblum, Juliette Lewis, Thomas Robinson Film jutustab Kassie'st, haritud ja lustilisest vallalisest naisest, kes oma kergelt neurootilise parima sõbra Wally vastuväidetest hoolimata otsustab, et just nüüd on paras aeg saada laps - isegi juhul, kui tuleb üksi hakkama saada, või siis täpsemalt - sarmika spermadoonori Rolandi (Patrick Wilson) abiga. Kassie plaanid lendavad talle enesele teadmata vastu taevast, sest viimase hetke muudatus tuleb päevavalgele alles seitse aastat hiljem, mil Wally kohtub viimaks Kassie varaküpse, ehkki kergelt neurootilise pojaga.

programme.title: Shawshanki lunastus
programme.desc: 7 Oscarile kandideerinud vangladraama noorest ja edukast pankurist, kelle maailm variseb kokku. Andy naine ja naise armuke langevad koletu veretöö ohvriks ning Andyle määratakse eluaegne vangistus Shawshanki vanglas. Vanemad olijad sõlmivad kihlvedusid, kes "uustulnukatest" esimest öödki vastu ei pea ja diktaatorliku vanglaülema rämeda surve all murduvad. Ajapikku Andy siiski kohaneb karmide mängureeglitega ja sõbruneb vana vangi Rediga.

programme.title: Spartacus
programme.desc: Noorem Batiatus leiab, et tema käes on kontroll isa gladiaatorite kooli üle. Ta kasutab oma osavaimat võitlejat, et võita uue areeni ehituse taga seisva noobli aadlimehe poolehoid.

programme.title: Homse piiril
programme.desc: Kassahitist põnevus-märul leitnant Billist, kes peab koos eriväelase Ritaga peatama tulnukate invasiooni. Ründajate vastu enesetapu-missioonile saadetud Bill hukkub lahingus mõne minutiga. Füüsiline kontakt tulnukaga käivitas aga "ajasõlme", nii et Bill ärkab igal järgmisel hommikul uuesti ellu ja peab selle lahingu uuesti maha pidama - kuni ta leiab mooduse, kuidas sellest võitjana välja tulla. Tal on abiks eriväelane Rita, kes on tapnud rohkem tulnukaid kui ükski teine inimene. Nendest sõltub, kas sissetungijad õnnestub hävitada ja planeet Maa päästa...

programme.title: Halastamatu maa
programme.desc: Salajane eriüksuse päästeoperatsioon Lõuna-Filipiinidel muutub julmaks 48-tunniseks ellujäämisvõitluseks. Kui eliitmeeskond satub vaenlase territooriumil varitsuse ohvriks, jääb noore ohvitseri Kinney õlgadele kogu päästeoperatsioon, sest ühtki meest maha ei jäeta. Vastaste õhurünnaku lähenedes ripub Kinney ainus lootus õhujõudude droonipiloodi Reaperil, kelle navigeerimioskusest sõltub, kas järgmine samm võib olla nende viimane.

programme.title: Püha Vincent
programme.desc: USA 2014 komöödia / draama Lavastaja:Theodore Melfi Osades: Bill Murray, Melissa McCarthy, Naomi Watts Vincent on üks pahur endine sõjaväeveteran, kes saab saatuse tahtel endale uued naabrid - Maggie ja tema 12-aastane adopteeritud poeg, Oliver. Kuid ühel päeval juhtub aga nii, et Oliver naaseb koolist koju, kuhu ta siseneda ei saa, olles oma koduvõtmed ära kaotanud, mispärast pöördub poiss oma "meeldiva" naabri poole palvega lubada tal oodata oma ema tema pool. Kuna Vincent on tegelikult ääreni võlgades, tekib tal idee hakata raha eest Oliverile lapsehoidjaks.Nagu arvatagi võib, on Vincent juba tüdinenud elukogenud mees ning tema lapsehoidmine pole sootukski mitte selline, mida võiks tavapäraseks nimetada, eriti tema elustiili juures, milleks on hasartmängud ja alkohol, ja kindlasti ei tohiks mainimata jätta tema vene rahvusest prostituudist armukest.

programme.title: Spartacus
programme.desc: Batiatus mõtleb välja kavala plaani ning värbab Lucretia, Gaia ja rahulolematuid gladiaatoreid, et see ellu viia. Oenomaus ihkab tagasi saada gladiaatorite kõrgeimat auastet, kuid tema ette kerkivad uued väljakutsed.

programme.title: Seks ja linn
programme.desc: Megahitist romantiline komöödia, mille aluseks samanimeline menuseriaal. Manhattan, hoia alt! Carrie, Samantha, Charlotte ja Miranda on tagasi, tuues endaga kaasa senisest veelgi keerukamad inimsuhted, efektsemad kostüümid ning rohkem kalleid kingi, kui enamus naisi elu jooksul kanda jõuaks. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.desc: Trio jõuab Šotimaale Invernessi ning valib võrdlemiseks soodsad Itaalia haruldused - Clarkson vaimustub Alfa Romeo GTV6st, May Lancia Gamma Coupe'st ja Hammond Fiat X1/9-st. Koos sõidetakse maanteel, kardirajal ja käänulisel külateel.

programme.title: Täheks sündinud
programme.desc: Täna astuvad vaatajate ette Elvis Presley, Heli Lääts, Britney Spears ja Koit Toome! Kõik see on võimalik üksnes selle kevade kõige vingemas muusikashows, kus täiesti tavalised inimesed kehastuvad vaid üheks õhtuks oma lemmikstaarideks. Parimatest parim võidab finaalis, kuhu pääseb vaid kõige ägedam võistkond, koguni 5000 eurot ja võidukarika. Kohtunikena hindavad shownumbreid hitimeister Stig Rästa, näitleja Peeter Oja, ooperidiiva Elina Nechayeva ning muusikatäht Synne Valtri. Saadet juhib Jüri Butšakov.

programme.title: Grand Tour
programme.desc: Kolmik on sunnitud minema autosuvilaga Nevadasse seiklema. Kui selgub, et antud autosuvila ei kõlba kuhugile, ehitavad nad ise oma parema versiooni. Nägemata ei jää ka Nevada tõmbenumbrid - bagiralli, romuralli ja Vegase stiilis pidu.

programme.title: Piire ületades
programme.desc: USA 2014 ulmepõnevik Lavastaja: Wally Pfister Osades: Johnny Depp, Rebecca Hall, Paul Bettany Dr Will Caster (Johnny Depp) on juhtiv teadlane tehisintellekti valdkonnas, kelle eesmärgiks on luua teadvust omav masin, kes kannaks endas nii kogu inimkonna poolt läbi aegade ammutatud infot kui ka kõiki inimemotsioone. Ta ülimalt vastuolulised katsed on talle kuulsust toonud, ent samas teinud tast ka tehnoloogiavastaste äärmuslaste peamise sihtmärgi. Nood teevad kõik, et teda peatada. Ent püüdes Willi hävitada, sunnivad äärmuslased tahtmatult teda hoopis edu nimel suuremat ohvrit tooma - ta otsustab end katsejänesena üleloomulikuks moondada. Ta naise Evelyni (Rebecca Hall) ja parima sõbra Max Watersi (Paul Bettany) jaoks, kes töötavad mõlemad sama projekti kallal, pole küsimus selles, kas nad suudavad seda teha, vaid selles, kas nad peaksid seda tegema. Nende suurimad kartused saavad tõeks, kui Willi teadmisjanu muutub näiliselt kõikehaaravaks võimuihaks, mille tagajärgi on võimatu ette aimata. Hirmutava tõsiasjana ilmneb vaid see, et teda võib olla võimatu peatada.

programme.title: Kolm reklaamtahvlit linna servas
programme.desc: USA/ Suurbritannia 2017 draama, komöödia,krimi Lavastaja:Martin McDonagh Osades:Frances McDormand, Woody Harrelson, Sam Rockwell, Peter Dinklage, Abbie Cornish, Caleb Landry Jones, John Hawkes Mildred Hayes (Oscari-võitja Frances McDormand) on eluraskuste poolt kõvaks keedetud lahutatud naine, keda piinab päevast päeva Missouri väikelinna Ebbingi politsei tegevusetus. Mildredi teismelise tütre mõrva uurimine pole kuhugi välja viinud ning mitme kuu jooksul pole kinni peetud ainsatki kahtlusalust. Naine paneb kohaliku konnatiigi lainetama, rentides linna toova maantee ääres kolm reklaamtahvlit, mille sisu on otseseks väljakutseks kohalikule korrakaitsele, täpsemalt šerif William Willoughbyle (Woody Harrelson). Kui sündmuste käiku sekkub šerifi parem käsi, ebaküps vägivaldne memmekas Dixon (Sam Rockwell), aitab see konflikti lahendamisele kaasa sama edukalt kui bensiiniga täidetud tulekustuti.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Paris - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Näeme, kuidas segased ajad majanduses, haavatud rahvuslik uhkus ja nn karismaatiline juhtimine põhjustasid teise maailmasõja ajal enneolematult jõhkraid tegusid, mida kujundasid Hitlerile kõige lähemal seisvad mehed ja naised.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler: diktaatorit dekodeerides
programme.desc: Kolmandat Reichi juhiti Führerprinzipi järgi, kuid Hitleri valitsemine poleks olnud võimalik ilma nende inimeste ja organisatsioonide toetuseta, kes tegid tema türannia võimalikuks.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler: diktaatorit dekodeerides
programme.desc: Arhitektuur oli Adolf Hitlerile väga oluline. Tema suurejoonelised nägemused ei olnud pelgalt ehitised, vaid türanliku visiooni sümbolid, eesmärgiga suruda peale maailma domineerimise tunnet.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler: diktaatorit dekodeerides
programme.desc: Adolf Hitleri diktatuuri lahtikodeerimisel väärib lahkamist küsimus, miks vajas kõikvõimas füürer tihedat ja pidevalt kättesaadavat suhtlusringi.

programme.title: Kadunud vaaraode jälil
programme.desc: Auguste Mariette avastas Saqqara serapeioni ja rajas teaduspõhise egüptoloogia. Kunagine rüüstaja asutas Egiptuse muististe teenistuse ja Kairo esimese muuseumi riigi kultuuripärandite kaitsmiseks.

programme.title: Kuningate org: salajase hauakambri väljakaevamine
programme.desc: Jälgime kuulsa Kuningate oru vaarao hauakambri esimest aktiivset väljakaevamist pärast seda, kui sajandi eest avastati vaarao Tutanhamoni haud, ning paljastame Egiptuse tuntud valitsejate uusi saladusi.

programme.title: Kuningate org: salajase hauakambri väljakaevamine
programme.desc: Jälgime kuulsa Kuningate oru vaarao hauakambri esimest aktiivset väljakaevamist pärast seda, kui sajandi eest avastati vaarao Tutanhamoni haud, ning paljastame Egiptuse tuntud valitsejate uusi saladusi.

programme.title: Kadunud püramiidi saladused
programme.desc: Liitu arheoloogidega, kes dekodeerivad välja kaevatud töölise 4500 aasta vanust päevikut. Kas nad suudavad taastada iidse paadi ja avada pikalt kadunud saladused Cheopsi püramiidi ehitamise kohta?

programme.title: Hitler vs Stalin
programme.desc: Kuigi Hitler ja Stalin päris elus kunagi ei kohtunud, osutus nende koostöö tänapäeva ajaloos pöördeliseks. See dokumentaalfilm paljastab 20. sajandi kõige kurikuulsama suhte uusi tahke.

programme.title: Hitler vs Stalin
programme.desc: Kuigi Hitler ja Stalin päris elus kunagi ei kohtunud, osutus nende koostöö tänapäeva ajaloos pöördeliseks. See dokumentaalfilm paljastab 20. sajandi kõige kurikuulsama suhte uusi tahke.

programme.title: Hitleri mängud värvilisena: Berliin 1936
programme.desc: 1936. aasta Berliini olümpiamängud tõid kaasa suuri uuendusi, sh mängude esimesed teleülekanded ja tõrvikujooksu. Näitame tipphetki ja seda, kuidas Hitler kasutas mänge oma julma režiimi propagandaks.

programme.title: Tõus ja langus: Teise maailmasõja pöördepunktid
programme.desc: Oleme tunnistajateks Teise maailmasõja viimastele hetkedele ja järelmõjudele, sõjatribunali, näiteks Nürnbergi protsessi kokkukutsumisele. Koos ÜRO loomisega liigume rahule vastu.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein ja Relika toovad väljakutselt jaoskonda eksootilise külalise kaasa. Noor juhataja hakkab kannatust kaotama ja salakaval Urmas hakkab oma seljataguse pärast muretsema. Rein tahab naisega ära leppida, kuid peab siis hoopis Relikalt öömaja paluma ja paneb sellega Relika uue suhte proovile. Rein ja Hans-Kristjan saavad aga tõuke riigikogulaste kadumise juhtumi lahendamiseks, samal ajal kui kõik jaoskonna töötajad saavad korraga vallandamiskäskkirja. Reinul pole nüüd enam midagi kaotada.

programme.title: Suvesangarid
programme.desc: "Suvesangarid" on lustlik suvine saade, mis tõestab, et igas Eestimaa nurgas on midagi vaatamist ja katsetamist väärt. Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Eesti rammumees ja rammunaine
programme.desc: 23aastased ja nooremad mehed tulid kokku ja selgitasid välja Eesti kõige tugevamad noorsportlased. Neile tuli konkurentsi pakkuma üks Läti noorsportlane. Kommenteerivad Tiit Loo ja endine rammumees Markus Männik.

programme.title: Eesti rammumees ja rammunaine
programme.desc: Eesti kergekaalu mehed pakuvad konkurentsi Läti ja Soome rammumeestele. Saame teada Eesti selle aasta tugevaima kergekaalu rammumehe ja seda, kas Eesti tugevaim võidab ka rahvusvahelises arvestuses. Tartu Lõunakeskuses toimunud võistlust kommenteerivad Tiit Loo ja Markus Männik.

programme.title: Ameerika paps
programme.desc: Klaus ja Hayley otsivad oma järgmist doosi pärast seda, kui nad on eufoorilise joobe saanud.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Relika saab oma ukraina kavalerilt ootamatu ettepaneku, mis sunnib Relikat kogu oma elu ümber hindama. Reinu ja noore juhataja suhe teravneb veelgi, kuid Hans-Krisjanil on idee, kuidas sundida Urmast uue juhataja vastu tunnistusi andma - ehk suudab see trikk jaoskonna päästa? Reinu poeg korraldab Reinule ja Reinu naisele üllatusliku kohtingu, kus nad saavad lõpuks oma suhte sasipuntra lahti harutada. Riigikogu liikmete röövimise juhtum võtab aga ootamatult uue dramaatilise pöörde.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Ambitsioonikas filminäitlejanna Penny kolib Pasadena korterisse, mis asub säravate ja sotsiaalselt kohmakate füüsikute Sheldon Cooperi ja Leonard Hofstadteri vastas ning näitab neile, kui vähe nad teavad elust väljaspool laborit.

programme.title: Kalamehejutud
programme.desc: Saate Kalamehejutud peamiseks eesmärgiks on tutvustada erinevate kalaliikide püüdmiseks vajalikke vahendeid, nippe ja kalastuskohti. Kalastushuvilisele inimesele mõeldud saatesarja igas osas keskendutakse ühe Eesti vetes elava kalaliigi püüdmisele ja sellest maitsva roa küpsetamisele. Saatejuhid on Kalev Kruus ja Vladislav Korzets.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Beni ja Semirit kahtlustatakse suures koguses kokaiini toimetamises narkokartelli valdusse. Nad satuvad vanglas kokku Pietiga, kes oli kunagi narkokuninga juures tööl. Ben, Semir ja Piet põgenevad koos vanglast, et oma süütust tõestada.

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur
programme.desc: Kui Alex röövitakse, läheb Walker viimaks Esimehega vastamisi.

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Saksamaa kiirteed on muutunud ühenduslüliks ida ja lääne vahel, kus liiguvad kõiksugu sorti hämarad tegelased ja eluohtlikud laadungid. Kiirteel töötavad politseinikud, kes ohtliku töö tegemisel kohtuvad päevast päeva lapseröövlite, salakaubitsejate, põgenike ja mõrtsukatega.

programme.title: Simpsonid
programme.desc: Bart saab teada, et ta oli kunagi lapsnäitleja telereklaamides, kuid töö eest saadud raha raiskas Homer süüstavate fotode ära ostmiseks. Vastumeetmena palub Bart kohtul end oma vanematest seaduslikult eraldada ja ta kolib Simpsonite majast välja.

programme.title: Ameerika paps
programme.desc: Klausist saab Snoti isafiguur, et Snoti ema kosida. Hayley avab kassikohviku ja palkab Rogeri töötajaks.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Ambitsioonikas filminäitlejanna Penny kolib Pasadena korterisse, mis asub säravate ja sotsiaalselt kohmakate füüsikute Sheldon Cooperi ja Leonard Hofstadteri vastas ning näitab neile, kui vähe nad teavad elust väljaspool laborit.

programme.title: Sandra saab tööd
programme.desc: Kodumaine draamafilm Sandrast (Mari Abel), kes kaotab ootamatult töö. Uue ameti otsimine kujuneb tragikoomiliseks katsumuseks - lõputud tööintervjuud viivad endise teadlase kokku kõikvõimalike olukordade ja persoonidega. Õhku jääb aga küsimus, kuidas selle kaose keskel ikkagi iseendaks jääda... Teistes osades Hendrik Toompere, Laine Mägi, Henrik Kalmet, Alo Kõrve, Tiina Tauraite, Mait Malmsten jpt.

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur
programme.desc: Kui Alex röövitakse, läheb Walker viimaks Esimehega vastamisi.

programme.title: Tenerife
programme.desc: Atraktiivne ja haarav tõsielusari, kus osalevad inimesed, keda huvitab elu reisijuhina eksootilises riigis. Välja valitud kümme osalejat lähevad seiklusele Tenerifele, kus kaamerate ees toimetulekuks osutuvad hädavajalikuks suhtlemisvabadus, julgus, tegutsemisvalmidus, kohanemisvõime ja muidugi isiklik sarm! Parimale võistlejale kuulub ihaldusvärne auhind! Sarja juhib vastupandamatu Eda - Ines Etti.

programme.desc: Hazen Audel alustab kõrgel pilvede kohal erakordset ellujäämisseiklust. Ta laskub Laose Mekongi vesikonna kõrgeimast punktist läbi pilvemetsa, otsides hmongi rahvast, kes jahib traditsioonilisi mürke kasutades, ja meisterdab Vietnami sõja šrapnellidest ellujäämiseks vajalikke tööriistu. Lõpuks otsib ta üles võimsa Mekongi jõe, kust ta loodab oma 800 km pikkusele rännakule õnnistust leida.

programme.title: Rait, Raivo ja naised teel Iraani

Iraan ei valmista oma külalislahkuse osas pettumust ning kohaliku abiga saab tee joomise kõrvalt broneeritud põnev hotell liivadüünide ääres, kuhu ka hilisõhtuks jõutakse. Hotell on samuti nagu ehtsas kunagises Pärsias - suur mudast ja põhust ruum, kuhu kaetakse laud kombekohaselt vaibale.

programme.title: Rait, Raivo ja naised teel Iraani
programme.desc: Reisiseltskond ärkab iidses mudahotellis ning läheb õue avastama, millised on need liivadüünid, kuhu automehed nii kangesti jõuda tahavad. Päeva edenedes tüütab Raiti pikk asfaltee ära ning ta otsustab proovida mõnda huvitavamat teed. Tunnid hiljem saame teada, et suund, mis Rait võttis on vale ja isegi keelatud. Õhtul linnas laagrivarusid täiendades eskorditakse meid kõiki aga politseijaoskonda..

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria

Penny meelest on nad haledad, et sellisele asjale nii palju aega raiskavad, aga see haavab Leonardi tundeid ja ta viskab kõik oma nohiklikud asjad ära.

Isepäistest sõduritest koosnev ülisalajane üksus asus natsidega võitlusse täiesti tavatuid ja äärmiselt väärituid võtteid kasutades. Nende julge lähenemine muutis sõja kulgu ja pani aluse Briti SAS-ile ja tänapäevastele salaoperatsioonidele.

Üks neist on ka Lucy peretuttav Andrew, kuid mees pole huvitatud ajakirjanikega rääkimisest. Kuna Lucy ülemus arvab, et tutvus Andrew'ga annaks loole isikliku alatooni, otsib Lucy Andrew üles. James teeb uue katse Rebeccaga, kes algul teeskleb talle korviandmist, kuid lõpuks siiski "jah" ütleb ja ta õnnelikuks teeb.

Ifakat korraldab häärberisse mineku isiklike asjade kättesaamise nime all, ent tegelikult tahab Seyran Cicekile vastu astuda.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

Kasuema ei võta teda kuigi südamlikult vastu, sest kardab, et tema tütre Alisoni abielu võib Kay tõttu ohtu sattuda. Kui isa ootamatult sureb, tunneb Kay kohustust talu edasi pidada. Tõuhobuste uued haigusjuhtumid annavad aga märku, et keegi tahtlikult ohustab võistlusratsude elu ja tervist.

Nende suurimaks vaenlaseks olid väledad utahraptorid, kelle vältimisest kujunes välja aastaid kestnud kassi-hiire mäng. Kuid mis juhtus siis, kui metsapõleng gastoniatel põgenemistee kinni pani?

programme.desc: Mööda Doonaud rändava Joanna teekond jätkub Rumeenias, kus ta kohtub Euroopa võimsamate nõidadega. Vahest kogu reisi eredaimad hetked ootavad teda aga tohutu suures Doonau deltas, kus Joanna näeb oma silmaga majesteetlikke pelikane ja ööpimeduses ulguvaid šaakaleid. Viimaks, pärast 2857 kilomeetrit, lõpeb reis Musta mere kaldal.

programme.title: Brian Johnson. Elu turneel
